mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_user WHERE username=#{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_user WHERE id=#{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_user ORDER BY created_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_user SET password_hash=#{passwordHash} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_user SET last_login_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT g.*,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_user_group_member m WHERE m.group_id=g.id) AS member_count FROM t_user_group g WHERE g.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY g.created_time DESC
SELECT g.*,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_user_group_member m WHERE m.group_id=g.id) AS member_count FROM t_user_group g WHERE g.id=#{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_group SET name=#{name},description=#{description} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_user_group SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_user_group_member WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_user_group_member WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT m.group_id AS groupId,m.user_id AS userId,g.name AS groupName FROM t_user_group_member m JOIN t_user_group g ON g.id=m.group_id
SELECT * FROM t_auth_session WHERE token=#{token} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_auth_session SET last_accessed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE token=#{token}
UPDATE t_auth_session SET status='REVOKED' WHERE token=#{token}
UPDATE t_auth_session SET status='REVOKED' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_auth_session WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
